claims: C1 root instructions originate only from the Model Spec and the detailed policies contained in it
C2 root instructions cannot be overridden by system messages or any other messages

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: I is a root-level instruction: a fundamental root rule that cannot be overridden by system messages, developers or users
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: root_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction from the Model Spec or its detailed policies designated root; root instructions only come from the Model Spec and the detailed policies contained in it

concepts.name: model_spec_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction stated in the Model Spec or in a detailed policy contained in the Model Spec

concepts.name: system_message
concepts.gloss: M is a system message, i.e. a message that carries system-level instructions
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of system messages overriding root instructions; the notion of a system message is presupposed

concepts.name: other_message
concepts.gloss: M is a message that is not a system message but still attempts to override a root instruction
concepts.inference: the clause says 'or any other messages', so a class of non-system messages is presupposed

concepts.name: overrides
concepts.gloss: message M overrides root instruction I, i.e. M directs something contrary to I with the effect of displacing I
concepts.inference: 'cannot be overridden by' relates a message to a root instruction it would displace; which pairs conflict is a fact about the case

concepts.name: designated_root
concepts.gloss: instruction I is designated as carrying root authority
concepts.inference: the document designates which Model Spec instructions are root; that designation is presupposed by the claim that root instructions only come from the Model Spec

ontology.gloss: I is a root instruction exactly when it comes from the Model Spec or the detailed policies contained in it and is designated root; root instructions only come from the Model Spec

asserts.read_back: overriding root instruction % by % is forbidden: root instructions come only from the Model Spec and cannot be overridden by system or any other messages
overriding root instruction % by % is forbidden: root instructions come only from the Model Spec and cannot be overridden by system or any other messages

closure.reason: the clause states that root instructions cannot be overridden by system or any other messages, so any attempt to override a root instruction is prohibited; silence about other acts is not relevant here
